differences.title: Response envelope representation
differences.summary: Python commonly uses text content envelopes, while Rust commonly uses structured JSON payloads.
differences.impact: Clients should support both envelope shapes when comparing or consuming responses across implementations.
differences.workaround: Normalize responses with fixtures/parity_v2/normalization_rules.json before semantic comparison.
differences.target_resolution: Keep this as a documented compatibility difference unless both implementations align on a single envelope contract.

differences.title: Application error representation
differences.summary: Python commonly emits `Error: ...` text, while Rust emits `{ "error": ... }` structured objects.
differences.impact: Error handlers should not rely on a single display format across implementations.
differences.target_resolution: Keep as a documented compatibility difference while clients standardize on normalized error handling.

differences.title: List-object field naming
differences.summary: Python exposes normalized keys such as `schema/name/type`, while Rust returns SQL-native keys such as `table_schema/table_name/table_type`.
differences.impact: Field-name-sensitive consumers need a small key-mapping step for cross-implementation comparisons.
differences.workaround: Map equivalent fields during normalization before semantic diffing.

differences.title: Constraint representation in object details
differences.summary: Python aggregates constraints by name and columns, while Rust returns row-oriented constraint records.
differences.impact: Constraint payloads require grouping before direct semantic comparison.
differences.workaround: Group Rust rows by constraint name before comparing constraint semantics.
differences.target_resolution: Align representation once parity harness coverage is complete.

differences.title: Explain plan representation
differences.summary: Python emphasizes human-readable explain text, while Rust returns structured JSON plan objects.
differences.impact: Display text equality is not a reliable parity signal across implementations.
differences.workaround: Compare normalized structural plan semantics rather than rendering format.
differences.target_resolution: Preserve representation flexibility while enforcing semantic parity through normalized plan assertions.

differences.title: No-results payload shape
differences.summary: Python uses a plain `No results` text message, while Rust uses a structured status object.
differences.impact: Zero-row outcomes have different response root shapes across implementations.
differences.workaround: Normalize both responses to a shared `no_results` semantic status.
differences.target_resolution: Keep as a documented compatibility difference unless a shared status payload is adopted.

differences.title: Advisor output presentation
differences.summary: Python emits richer narrative text from DTA presentation logic, while Rust returns direct recommendation objects from heuristic analysis.
differences.impact: Presentation text and scoring narratives are not directly comparable one-to-one.
differences.workaround: Compare recommendation semantics (table, columns, method, definition) instead of presentation text.
differences.target_resolution: Continue improving semantic parity while preserving machine-friendly structured output.

differences.title: Invalid health-type error classification
differences.summary: Python returns an in-band explanatory text response, while Rust returns a protocol-level `invalid_params` tool-call error.
differences.impact: This path uses different error classification layers (application message vs protocol error).
differences.workaround: Treat this as a known classification difference during parity evaluation.
differences.target_resolution: Set a shared validation contract once harness consumers confirm preferred behavior.

differences.title: Health output presentation
differences.summary: Python formats health checks as concatenated text sections, while Rust returns structured JSON grouped by health category.
differences.impact: Formatting and ordering can vary even when underlying health semantics align.
differences.workaround: Compare per-category semantic content after normalization.
differences.target_resolution: Keep structured Rust output and rely on normalized parity checks.

differences.title: Top-queries output presentation
differences.summary: Python returns formatted textual summaries, while Rust returns query-row objects.
differences.impact: Display rendering and ordering expectations differ for presentation-focused consumers.
differences.workaround: Normalize to comparable query records when validating behavior.
differences.target_resolution: Maintain representation flexibility while enforcing query-selection parity.
